# DataCard

```ts
import { DataCard } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A card that holds data — a table, a chart, KPIs, or a mix — with a consistent header and footer (Figma hellopc.data.card, node 18275:745; from the Sales Sphere "Pipeline health" and "Recent orders" modules). Use it to frame a data module on a dashboard. For marketing or navigation content use Content Card / Simple Card; for a bare surface use Card.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Card title (Figma title), medium 20px. Also the section's accessible name. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional one-line description under the title (Figma showDescription). |
| `tools` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Header tools, right-aligned: a segments ContentSwitcher (size="sm", intent="secondary"), an "AI summary" Button (size="sm" primary tonal), a "more" IconButton (size="sm" ghost) — any subset. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | — | The data — a Table, a chart, KPIs — shown in the bordered content well. |
| `sources` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Footer provenance line, e.g. "Sources: Source name · As of 05 Dec 2026" (12px). |
| `footerAction` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Footer action — a "View all" Button (size="sm" primary ghost). |
| `headingLevel` | `'h2' \| 'h3' \| 'h4'` | `'h2'` | Heading level for the title, to fit the page outline. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<DataCard title="Pipeline health">{table}</DataCard>
<DataCard title="Pipeline health" description="Open opportunities by stage.">{table}</DataCard>
<DataCard title="Pipeline health" tools={<>{segments}{aiSummary}{more}</>}>{table}</DataCard>
<DataCard title="Pipeline health" sources="Sources: Salesforce · As of 05 Dec 2026" footerAction={<Button size="sm" intent="primary" variant="ghost">View all</Button>}>{table}</DataCard>
<DataCard title="Recent orders" headingLevel="h3">{chart}</DataCard>
```

## Accessibility

- The card is a <section> labelled by its title, so it appears as a named region. Set headingLevel so the title fits the page's heading outline.
- Label the segments ContentSwitcher (aria-label) and make the "more" IconButton label card-specific ("More for Pipeline health").
- The content keeps its own semantics — a Table needs its own aria-label.
- "View all" should say where it goes when several cards share a page — pass an aria-label such as "View all opportunities".

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Say where the data comes from and how fresh it is in sources | Leave people guessing whether numbers are live |
| Keep tools to segments, AI summary, and one more menu | Fill the header with buttons |
| Put one data view in the content well | Stack unrelated tables in one card |
| Use Card for non-data content | Add a shadow or change the radius to make it "pop" |
